newsitem.title: USA: Multi-Market to exchange, redeem warrants.
newsitem.headline: Multi-Market to exchange, redeem warrants.

text.p: Multi-Market Radio Inc said on Tuesday it began an exchange offer for its outstanding Class B warrants, as part of its proposed merger into SFX Broadcasting Inc.
The company said it would offer one Class A common share in exchange for each five Class B Warrants tendered.
Multi-Market also said it had decided to redeem all its outstanding Class A Warrants but that this move did not hinge on the completion of the proposed merger.
The exchange offer for the Class B warrants, which did not hinge on the completion of the merger, expired on November 6 at 1700 EDT/2100 GMT, the company said.
A company spokeswoman said the exchange of the Class B warrants would eliminate most of the warrants from the balance sheet of the merged entity. These warrants had not been in the money, she said.
The company said Class A Warrants not validly exercised by 1700 EDT/2100 GMT on November 7 would be redeemed the next day for $0.01 per warrant.

Multi-Market said it had the right to redeem the Class A warrants because the average closing bid price of the Class A common stock had exceeded $10.75 per share for a period of 20 consecutive business days.
SFX Broadcasting and Multi-Market said on October 3 that they had amended their merger agreement to guarantee a minimum payment of $12.50 per share to Multi-Market shareholders.
